title: MCP Tool: get_project_stats
description: Analyses a .NET solution or project file and returns key architectural metrics as structured JSON data, including project counts by type, dependency depth statistics, and the most-referenced projects. Useful for AI assistants making architectural recommendations or monitoring solution health.

path.description: Absolute path to a .NET solution file (.sln or .slnx) or a project file (.csproj).

topN.description: Number of top most-referenced projects to include in the hotspot list. Defaults to 5.

output.description: JSON-serialised SolutionStats. All fields are always present.

solutionName.description: Name of the analysed solution or project.

solutionPath.description: Absolute path to the analysed file.

totalProjectCount.description: Total number of projects in the graph, excluding NuGet package nodes.

typeBreakdown.description: Count of projects per type. Keys are ProjectType names: Library, Executable, Test, Other.

depthStats.description: Aggregate dependency depth statistics. All values are -1 when hasCycles is true.

average.description: Mean longest-path depth across all projects.

min.description: Minimum depth (0 for leaf projects with no dependencies).

max.description: Maximum depth (depth of the project with the longest dependency chain).

hotspotProjects.description: Top-N most directly-referenced projects, ranked descending by inDegree.

inDegree.description: Number of other projects that directly reference this project.

hasCycles.description: True if a dependency cycle was detected in the graph. When true, depthStats values are all -1.

errorBehaviour.invalidPath: Throws FileNotFoundException; MCP SDK surfaces as tool error response.
errorBehaviour.emptyGraph: Returns valid SolutionStats with totalProjectCount=0 and empty collections.
errorBehaviour.cyclesDetected: Returns valid SolutionStats with hasCycles=true; depthStats.average/min/max all set to -1.
